model.name: Folder.acceptDrop
model.description: The DropTarget contract on Folder: accept dropped files INTO this folder -> ONE create path parented to this folder (createFileUnit(parent=folderRef)); STORAGE (room fileUnits / MODEL_STORE) resolved from the folder OWN context inside the create path. RENDER rides folderChildrenUnder+isDirectChildOfNode (shipped). Supersedes DropDispatcher.acceptDropIntoContainer a81ed3db.
